note: D4 focus on skip: the floor-1 draft is skipped (draft_skip sets the stored focus to 1; a skip never pays bloom), so the floor-2 draft rolls one EXTRA slot - four offers instead of three, the last reported focus and rolled by the affinity role (overgrowth, growth), and the event carries focus true. The two rolls also pin the Block D6 parity rule on one run: the upgrade slot deals solar_lance+noon entering floor 2 and seed_bomb+reclaim entering floor 3, the A sibling on the even floor and the B sibling on the odd one, because Content.variant_for indexes variants_of by the floor being entered and spends no rng draw doing it. The upgrade filter rides along in both: the tender holds mycelium_dash, but neither of its variants is build-defining, so the slot deals a lance and then a seed-bomb variant and never the dash. The roll spends the flag whether or not the player picks, so the record ends with focus already back to 0 while its four offers are still on the table - that 0 is in snapshot() and in state_hash(). The floor-2 leg between the two drafts is a baked action list playing to the stairs (cleanse the quota, descend); it is how the second descent is reached, not what the record is about
